title: Chapter 250: The Alien Interception
content:
Chapter 250: The Alien Interception

Wu Qing was not surprised that the aliens could accurately find the location of the Zerg army and had a certain understanding of the Zerg army. The goblins everywhere were the eyes of the aliens.

These goblins were very annoying. The Zerg army had no energy to clean them up now. Wu Qing was going to wait for the Zerg base here to be established, just like the underground world, to increase the number of Zerg puppies indefinitely and clean up all the goblins in the entire war zone.

Then copy the goblin model and use Zerg puppies to occupy all the areas outside the city of the aliens, so that the aliens can feel what it feels like to be surrounded by a sea of Zerg puppies.

[I hope readers will remember our domain name Taiwan Novel Network →𝔱𝔴𝔨𝔞𝔫.𝔠𝔬𝔪]

The aliens sent out powerful light griffin knights, and their target was definitely the Zerg destroyer. As long as they defeated the super long-range attack arms in the Zerg army, the aliens were not afraid of other Zerg arms.

Theoretically, the success rate of using flying soldiers with high mobility and strong attack capabilities to launch a surprise attack on the marching Zerg army is still very high.

The mysterious human knight was rescued, and a lot of information about the Zerg army was mastered by the aliens.

The aliens judged that the number of people that the Zerg army could kill with mysterious power in a short period of time should be around 100. As long as the number of powerful soldiers sent out is sufficient, the impact of the Zerg's ability on the battle situation can be offset.

In this regard, the aliens really guessed right. They sent so many powerful light griffin knights at a time, which really had a certain impact on the Zerg army. The number of Zerg queens doubled, but there were only 200.

In addition to the Zerg queen's ability to lay eggs, it is still difficult to say how other Zerg soldiers will kill the light griffin knights, but it is definitely not possible to kill them in one shot.

Even the self-detonation attack of the five-star Zerg explosive mosquito is estimated to be ineffective.

When the five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes were used to bomb the cavalry of the alien army, the ten five-star knights were not killed.

These light griffin knights should be more powerful, so it is a bit troublesome to deal with them.

Unless the queen uses the Zerg host to attack, it is easy to make people misunderstand that the strong behind the Zerg has taken action, which may trigger an unpredictable battle between the strong, which is not worth the loss.

"As long as the Zerg base is built, the lost troops can be replenished at any time!"

"Now let's aim to eliminate more enemies and earn more resources!"

Wu Qing no longer thinks about the loss of the Zerg army. Even if some Zerg destroyers are killed by the light griffin knights of the aliens, it will not affect the subsequent battle to capture the city.

At most, some five-star Zerg destroyers can be upgraded to make up for the lack of troops with strength.

What needs to be considered now is how to keep as many of the attacking light griffin knights of the aliens as possible.

Two thousand five-star Zerg Hydralisks led all the high-star Zerg Hydralisks and mixed into the long marching team of Zerg Destroyers.

Two thousand five-star Zerg Dragons also took the high-star Zerg Dragons and formed a highly mobile team separately, ready to intercept and pursue the incoming alien light griffon knights at any time.

Two hundred five-star Zerg Queens and one hundred and twenty five-star Zerg Blasting Swarms mixed in the group of more than 100,000 Zerg Dragons, hovering over the entire Zerg army.

The attack range of Zerg Queens and Zerg Blasting Swarms is very wide, enough to provide protection for the entire Zerg army of more than 900,000.

After Wu Qing made these preparations for the Zerg army, he no longer paid attention to the alien light griffon knights who had been lingering in the distance. The Zerg army marched normally and focused on the road.

The detection ability of the Zerg host is very strong, and it can hide itself and not attract attention.

All the actions of the Light Griffin Knights of the Alien Tribe were seen by the Zerg, but those Light Griffin Knights were unaware of this and thought their actions were very secretive.

Especially after Wu Qing replaced the previous four-star Zerg host with a five-star Zerg host, a large area around the Zerg army where they marched was closely monitored by the Zerg host.

Soon, Wu Qing found that the number of goblins gathered in the area where the Zerg army passed was increasing.

After the Zerg army continued to march for about an hour, the number of goblins gathered near the Zerg army almost exceeded 10 million.

Looking down through the vision of the Zerg host, there were densely packed small green figures around the more than 900,000 Zerg troops and some of the elite cavalry of the Bull Tribe, which basically surrounded the Zerg army.

The marching speed of the Zerg army was very fast. It was very difficult for these goblins to carry out such a large-scale mobilization and eventually form a siege against the Zerg army.

From this point, we can see that the command ability of the aliens is strong and their control over the goblins is thorough.

The aliens seem to understand that it is very undesirable to rely on the Light Griffin Knights to attack the Zerg army alone.

First mobilize a group of goblins to fight with the Zerg army, and then look for opportunities to use the Light Griffin Knights to attack. This will have a higher success rate.

Moreover, the Zerg army is heading east, and it must be looking for trouble with the aliens. The alien army can just use this opportunity to deepen its understanding of the Zerg army.

Only by knowing yourself and the enemy can you take the initiative in future battles with the Zerg army.

Faced with the Goblin blockade, the Zerg army was very calm and continued to march at a normal speed, seemingly not taking the large number of Goblins seriously.

The Goblins' marching speed still couldn't catch up with the Zerg army. If the Zerg army continued to march, the Goblin encirclement would have problems.

The Goblins no longer waited, and suddenly swarmed up and rushed towards the marching Zerg army.

Countless green little figures like goblins, wearing simple leather armor, holding various weapons, screamed and charged.

The marching Zerg destroyer team, among which those two-star Zerg destroyers, with the support of precise intelligence provided by the Zerg host, launched an attack on the most densely populated area of the rushing Goblins while walking.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Tens of thousands of liquid fireball shells soared into the air, flying in all directions at high speed towards their respective targets, like brilliant fireworks blooming.

Those goblins, who were only at the bottom of the ordinary army, were as fragile as paper men in the face of such attacks. The explosion of a large liquid fireball bomb could clear out a large area of goblins.

Obviously, the aliens had anticipated this situation long ago. Tens of millions of goblins were scattered in a huge area. Although the attack power of the Zerg destroyer was strong, the coverage was far from enough.

Even if a shell fired by a Zerg destroyer could kill dozens or hundreds of goblins at the beginning, as the goblins lost their manpower, the killing efficiency of the Zerg destroyer would be greatly reduced.

It was basically impossible for the Zerg army to quickly eliminate tens of millions of goblins.

This was also the case. The more than 900,000 Zerg troops on the march had a long formation, which was a formation that was redeployed and adjusted when facing the threat of the aliens.

More than 40,000 liquid fireball shells were distributed in the vast space around them, which seemed a bit powerless.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The second round of attack by the two-star Zerg Destroyer began, and those goblins close to the Zerg army had already rushed to the front of the Zerg army.

The Zerg Destroyer ignored these goblins and only attacked the goblins in the most densely populated area.

More than 400,000 Zerg Hydralisks, the absolute main force of the Zerg army, were scattered in various positions of the Zerg army. Among them, the one-star and two-star Zerg Hydralisks sprayed Zerg biological decomposition liquid at the rushing goblins.

The absolute gap in strength between the two sides greatly increased the power of the Zerg biological decomposition liquid. As long as the ordinary goblins were sprayed a little, they would almost lose their combat ability and could only wait for death in pain.

The goblins commanded by the aliens distributed their troops too sparsely in order to reduce the threat of the powerful long-range attack of the Zerg army.

This reduced the killing efficiency of the Zerg army's long-range attack, but also reduced the continuity of their own attacks on the Zerg army.

The Zerg army only had low-star Zerg Destroyers and Zerg Hydralisks to fire, and they successfully resisted the attack of the Goblins, leaving the marching speed of the Zerg army unaffected.

This attack and counterattack lasted for a while, and the aliens seemed to no longer care about the loss of the Goblins, and gathered a large number of Goblins in front of the Zerg army to block the Zerg army from moving forward.

The Goblins attacking the Zerg army from other directions also invested more and more troops, and the continuity of the attack became stronger and stronger, which made the Zerg Destroyers and Zerg Hydralisks who counterattacked at a certain rhythm feel a certain pressure.

Some low-star Zerg Dragons and Zerg Cockroaches in the Zerg army began to participate in the counterattack and attack the rushing Goblins.

Slowly, most of the troops of the entire Zerg army were mobilized to fire, and the marching speed of the Zerg army was also getting slower and slower.

Faced with this situation, Niu Zhong of the Bull Clan found Wu Qing and said to him: "Since the alien race has mobilized such a large number of goblins to participate in the battle, there will definitely be further actions. We must be careful to prevent the surprise attack of the alien army!"

Even the relatively honest people of the Bull Clan can see the problem, and the alien race will definitely have a response. Sure enough, not long after, the host of the Zerg discovered the armies of other affiliated races of the alien race who came to participate in the battle.

When the army of the affiliated races of the alien race, whose overall strength is not much weaker than that of the Bull Clan, joined the battle, the blocking battle launched by the alien race was pushed to another level.

Because the crazy sweep of the alien army in this area some time ago, there were almost no local army activities in this area, and the Zerg army was equivalent to fighting alone.
